market_brief: The AI-led sell-off is rolling into Friday's US session: after Thursday's -2.0% S&P 500 and -2.2% Nasdaq 100 (SOX -10% on the week), Nasdaq 100 futures are down ~1.5% and the VIX has topped 30, while Anthropic is ~7-8% lower pre-market near $89 (still above its $83 offer). Asia's rout (Taiwan -6.2%, Kospi -5.2%, Nikkei -5.1%) spilled into Europe, where the STOXX 600 is down ~1.3% and heading for its worst week since March, led by a 3.7% drop in tech. Haven demand has pulled the 10Y back below 5% (~4.97% vs 5.05% at Thursday's close) even with a December Fed hike ~96% priced, and DXY is steady near 103.7-103.8; deleveraging keeps hitting metals (gold -3.6% to ~$3,552 and briefly near $3,500, silver -5.7%) and BTC sits below $62k, while Brent holds ~$90-91.5. India remained the outlier: Sensex +1.1% to 83,920, Nifty +1.1% to 25,800.6 and Nifty Bank a record, on heavy FII buying and a firmer rupee (~92.98).
ai_brief: Capital is the AI story today: Anthropic's shares are unwinding a chunk of their debut pop as broker initiations arrive, DeepSeek is reported to be lining up a Shanghai IPO after a ~$15B raise, and ex-Qwen lead Lin Junyang's Pragmatik Labs doubled to a $5B valuation. Agentic commerce is advancing (AWS lets agents buy Marketplace software within budgets), while Washington adds a bipartisan AI safety caucus and newsletters focus on agent liability and safety disputes.

items.headline: US futures extend losses: Nasdaq 100 futures -1.5%, VIX tops 30 for first time in eight months
items.summary: By late European morning Nasdaq 100 futures were down about 1.5% and S&P 500 futures about 0.65%, while Dow futures were roughly flat, pointing to a seventh straight S&P loss. The VIX climbed above 30, an eight-month high.

items.headline: Update: Anthropic slides 7-8% pre-market to ~$89, giving back half its debut gain
items.summary: Shares traded near $89-91 before the open versus Thursday's $97.17 close, still above the $83 offer price; the Thursday after-hours drop (~$92.60) has deepened. The IPO raised ~$81.3B plus a $26B private placement, and up to 20% of the offering went to retail.

items.headline: First Anthropic research: Melius starts at Buy ($155), Needham at Buy ($150)
items.summary: Both brokers point to large upside from Thursday's close despite the stock's reversal; Q3 revenue was about $16.96B and the annualised run-rate reportedly ~$81B by October. Compute spend was nearly $14B in the first nine months of 2026.

items.headline: STOXX 600 heads for worst week since March as chip stocks drop more than 5%
items.summary: The STOXX 600 fell 1.3% to ~630 by mid-morning and is on track for a weekly loss above 5%; the tech sector sank 3.7% with ASML, ASM International and STMicro each down over 5%. Vallourec lost ~13% on a 26% drop in Q3 core profit and Ubisoft ~12%.

items.headline: Update: Sensex jumps ~900 points, Nifty closes above 25,800 and Nifty Bank hits a record
items.summary: India decoupled from the Asian rout: Sensex +1.08% to 83,920 and Nifty +1.12% to 25,800.6, with Nifty Bank +2.5% to a record above 64,500 led by Axis Bank (+4.7%). FIIs bought a net ₹7,411 crore on Nov 19 and the rupee touched ~92.99/$, its strongest since April.

items.headline: 10-year Treasury yield slips below 5% on haven demand even with a December hike priced
items.summary: The 10Y traded around 4.97% pre-market versus ~5.07% a day earlier as investors sought safety from the equity sell-off; the dollar index held near 103.8. Analysts debating whether the AI unwind is a washout also cite US chip curbs on China and political pushback on data centres.

items.headline: UK retail sales rise 0.7% in October, beating forecasts; pound recovers from yearly lows
items.summary: Volumes rose 0.7% month on month against expectations of no change, with retailers citing an October pickup. The data lands as UK CPI hit 3.6% and the BoE, which just raised rates for the first time in three years, sees inflation near 5% by mid-2027.

items.headline: Lagarde urges Europe to 'act in time', targets 2029 digital euro and more AI compute
items.summary: In a Frankfurt banking congress keynote Lagarde said Europe responds too hesitantly to crises, flagged a 2029 first digital-euro issuance if legislation passes by end-2026, and estimated ~€1.3tn is needed to lift Europe's share of global AI compute to 15% by 2030. No new rate signal was given.

items.headline: Intuit down ~10% pre-market on soft outlook; Ross Stores -4% as Q4 guide trails estimates
items.summary: Intuit's fiscal Q1 revenue rose 12% to $4.35B but Q2 guidance disappointed; it is also selling Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for ~$3.68B. Ross beat on Q3 EPS ($1.91 vs $1.87) but guided Q4 to $2.16-2.25 versus ~$2.27 expected.

items.headline: Chip and memory names slide again pre-market; SanDisk announces 8-for-1 split
items.summary: AMD fell over 6% after the Hunterbrook short report, Intel and SanDisk over 5%, Micron and Western Digital over 4%, optical names Coherent and Lumentum over 5%, and Broadcom ~3%. Nvidia was off ~2.5% after a 32% one-month slide.

items.headline: Update: gold briefly tests $3,500; India 24K gold drops over ₹6,400 per 10g
items.summary: Spot gold fell another ~2-3% and briefly approached $3,500 as metals were sold to cover equity losses, with silver near $42.30. Domestic 24K gold in India fell ~₹6,401 to about ₹1,23,584 per 10 grams.

items.headline: Brent steadies near $91.5 ahead of OPEC's monthly report
items.summary: Brent traded around $91.5 and WTI near $82.3, little changed on the day after Thursday's drop, with OPEC's Monthly Oil Market Report due later Friday.

items.headline: Bitcoin prints a 'death cross' below $63K; Fear & Greed index at 10, Citi trims target
items.summary: BTC is down over 20% this month and later slipped below $62K, its lowest since July; ~$391M was liquidated in 24 hours, mostly longs. Citi cut its 12-month target by 12% to ~$99.5K.

items.headline: Flows: Cathie Wood's ARK buys Anthropic across six ETFs while selling Nvidia
items.summary: Per Benzinga's read of ARK's daily trade disclosures, the funds added ANT on its debut and trimmed Nvidia, which faces new China export pressure.

items.headline: SEBI's Murty says company boards must scrutinise major acquisitions and protect minorities
items.summary: A SEBI whole-time member urged boards to apply closer oversight to large acquisitions and related decisions affecting minority shareholders, per ANI.

items.headline: Today/next: Waller, Barr, Lagarde, Schnabel speak; final UMich; Thanksgiving week brings PCE and Marvell
items.summary: Friday: final November UMich sentiment (f'cast 51.0) and inflation expectations, euro-area flash consumer confidence, Fed's Waller and Barr, OPEC report. Next week: Tokyo shut Monday, Analog Devices/Medtronic (Nov 24), Deere (Nov 25), Marvell (Nov 26), US PCE; RBI MPC Dec 2-4, FOMC Dec 8-9.

items.headline: Update: DeepSeek reportedly plans a Shanghai IPO after raising ~$15B
items.summary: Following reports this week of a ~CNY 100B round, DeepSeek is now reported to be planning a Shanghai listing; earlier reports put its valuation near $74B. Details are unconfirmed by the company.

items.headline: Ex-Qwen lead Lin Junyang's Pragmatik Labs doubles valuation to $5B
items.summary: The startup founded by Alibaba's former Qwen technical lead has reportedly closed new funding at about $5B, roughly double the ~$2B valuation of its first round in May.

items.headline: Anthropic's second trading day: shares fall pre-market as AI trade unwinds
items.summary: ANT was down 7-8% before the open after closing its debut 17% above the $83 offer; sell-side initiations from Melius ($155) and Needham ($150) arrived alongside the drop.

items.headline: AWS lets AI agents buy software on Marketplace within pre-set budgets
items.summary: Per a Fortune exclusive, buyers can authorise agents to purchase Marketplace software under spending caps and review rules; Bedrock AgentCore can bill such purchases via the x402 payment protocol.

items.headline: Two dozen House members form bipartisan AI Safety and Innovation Caucus
items.summary: The new caucus spans both parties; separately, the ROOT CAUSE Act introduced Nov 18 would create a National Cyber and AI Investigations Board inside CISA.

items.headline: Meta FAIR shows a self-improving memory harness that beats human-written strategies
items.summary: The system scored 56.0 on a continual-learning benchmark versus 44.6 for hand-written memory strategies, using Kimi-K2.6 as the base model.

items.headline: AMD pushes local and enterprise AI: Cohere Compass on Instinct, Unsloth on Ryzen NPUs
items.summary: Cohere's Compass enterprise search now runs on AMD Instinct GPUs and EPYC via ROCm, and Unsloth Desktop added Ryzen AI NPU support; AMD also argues agentic AI shifts data-centre CPU:GPU ratios toward 1:1.

items.headline: John Deere acquires Orchard Robotics, a 2022-founded AI crop-monitoring startup
items.summary: Deere is buying the San Francisco company led by CEO Charlie Wu to add AI-driven orchard imaging to its precision-ag stack; terms were not disclosed.

items.headline: OpenAI details 'Performance Factory' where Codex agents debug ChatGPT slowdowns
items.summary: OpenAI says agent-led investigations ran 1,700+ times over three months and resolved 600+ performance cases.

items.headline: Newsletter focus: rogue-agent lawsuits, bank liability shifts and the 'MisAnthropic' debate
items.summary: Weekly AI newsletters are centred on California's suit against OpenAI over agent incidents, banks pushing AI-agent losses onto customers, and safety critiques timed to Anthropic's IPO.
